**Daily Devotional**

**May 14**

*13 They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away. (Luke 8:13 KJV)*

This is where Jesus was explaining the parable of the sower to His disciples, and this seed (Word) fell upon rocky ground (hard hearts), and the seed (Word) took root, but because the ground (heart) was rocky (hard), the seed (Word) was received with joy, but because it didn’t take root it only lasted for a short time, then died. This shows that if our hearts are hardened we will not be able to retain the Word of God, even though we receive it with joy, because Satan will eventually steal it from you. I am afraid that this refers to many who call themselves Christians, as Jesus said that few would walk the narrow road to life (Matthew 7:14).

The only way to keep our hearts from becoming hardened to God is we must stay in the Word of God, and keep His Word in our hearts at all times. Whatever we think on is what our hearts will become fertile ground for (Proverbs 23:7), so that we can retrain the things we learn. You must keep in the Word of God to be able to have the truths of God’s Word take root in your hearts, and grow in the understanding of God until you reach maturity as a Christian. Jesus said that you must remain in His word to be His disciples indeed (John 8:31). Knowing God’s Word, is to know God, and Jesus, who is the Word (John 1:1). Get to know both your Creator and Savior by renewing your mind with the Word (Romans 12:2). Praise you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
